cohort: 2,733 pregnant women who delivered live birth singletons at full term at four tertiary care centers, teaching university hospitals between January and December 2012
finding: High pre-pregnancy BMI, using WPRO criteria, increased the risk of pregnancy complications and adverse pregnancy outcomes among Asian women.
mod_finding: High pre-pregnancy BMI was associated with an increased risk of induction of labor, prolonged second stage of labor, caesarean delivery, and obstetric procedures.
